bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
root=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed
release="$root/.releases/37d1ce2cd32ebf4c1fd7ca32a95add62443d191b/preview-instructions-no-fee"
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 61
test -s "$release/src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs" && test -s "$release/candidate-tests.log" && test -s "$release/baseline-tests.log" || exit 62
live="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')"
tagged="$(docker image inspect create-videobot:local-poll --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null || echo missing)"
old="$(docker image inspect create-videobot:before-preview-instructions-37d1ce2c --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null || echo missing)"
next="$(docker image inspect create-videobot:preview-instructions-37d1ce2c-verified --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null || echo missing)"
echo VIDEO_PREVIEW_STAGE_TESTS_EXIST=YES
if test "$live" = "$tagged";then echo VIDEO_LIVE_MATCHES_DEPLOY_TAG=YES;else echo VIDEO_LIVE_MATCHES_DEPLOY_TAG=NO;fi
if test "$live" = "$old";then echo VIDEO_LIVE_MATCHES_BEFORE_IMAGE=YES;else echo VIDEO_LIVE_MATCHES_BEFORE_IMAGE=NO;fi
if test "$live" = "$next";then echo VIDEO_LIVE_MATCHES_NEW_IMAGE=YES;else echo VIDEO_LIVE_MATCHES_NEW_IMAGE=NO;fi
if test "$next" = missing;then echo VIDEO_PREVIEW_CANDIDATE_IMAGE=ABSENT;exit 63;fi
if test "$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(sha256sum "$release/src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs" | awk '{print $1}')";then echo VIDEO_LIVE_PREVIEW_TARGET=NEW;else echo VIDEO_LIVE_PREVIEW_TARGET=OLDER_OR_OTHER;fi
echo VIDEO_READ_ONLY_STATUS=PASS
